activities.anchor: Laura Nader issued the call to "study up"
activities.caption: bet on which way the gaze turns
activities.name: anStudyUpPredict

config.q: Nader's 1969 call to "study up" asked anthropologists to do what?
choices: Study only societies with written records
Turn the ethnographic gaze on the powerful — boardrooms, regulators, standards bodies — not only on the governed
Abandon fieldwork for archival research on elites
Study upward through the generations, across kinship lines
config.why: The powerful have cultures too, and those cultures have consequences. Traweek's physicists (1988) answered for particle physics: tribes with a cosmology, a creation myth, and a status economy fought out over detector authorship lists.

activities.anchor: a practice is functioning as ritual when skipping it
activities.caption: true or false — the ritual survival test
activities.name: anRitualJudge

statements.s: Modernity means the end of ritual — rational societies outgrow ceremony.
statements.why: Rituality was not abandoned, it was re-staffed. Product launches, graduations, courtrooms and standups are rites of aggregation, intensification and passage in the Victorian sense.

statements.s: The test for ritual is whether skipping it creates anxiety out of proportion to its information content.
statements.why: Which describes the daily standup precisely — and explains why remote work broke something rituals used to carry.

statements.s: What is decided in the corridor counts only after the meeting ratifies it.
statements.why: Ethnomethodology's finding: meeting ritual produces organisational reality rather than merely reporting it.

statements.s: A standup is only information transfer, so a written digest is equivalent.
statements.why: By the anxiety test it is functioning as ritual — solidarity and institutional time-keeping — which a digest cannot carry.

activities.caption: find the faulty line in this Wall Street reading
activities.name: anHoSpot

config.prompt: A student summarises Ho's fieldwork. One line is wrong — find it.
lines: Ho did fieldwork on Wall Street after her own stint as an investment banker.
She found a culture of 'smartness' — prestige recursively defined by employer ranking.
She found job insecurity treated as a regrettable cost that bankers privately resented and resisted.
Bankers narrated constant layoffs as normal and even virtuous, which explains why a firm would gut its own experienced workforce every downturn.
The role writes the person: analysts internalise expendability, and the system gets loyalty through its opposite.
config.correction: Job insecurity was a VALUE, not a grievance — bankers narrated layoffs as normal and even virtuous.
config.why: It is the strongest single demonstration that markets are made of meanings: status and role producing behaviour economics alone cannot explain.

activities.anchor: the corporation is a legal person (Citizens United
activities.caption: file each claimant to personhood
activities.name: anPersonhoodBuckets

config.prompt: Mauss defined personhood as a category with a history. File each extension of it:

items.label: the corporation — Citizens United (2010) extended its speech rights in the US
people apologising to chatbots and crediting them with intent

config.why: The analytical move is not to adjudicate whether a model 'really' has a mind but to study personification as a social practice: what work does treating a system as someone do — for designers, users, regulators? Personhood expands to fit the institutions that need it.

activities.anchor: Nick Seaver's fieldwork among music-recommendation engineers
activities.caption: pair each fieldworker with the tribe they found
activities.name: anTribeMatch

config.prompt: Modern institutions are tribes with insides. Match each ethnographer to their finding:

pairs.right: a cosmology of eternal machine-independent laws and a creation myth of the heroic experiment
an identity built around shared expendability
developers defining themselves against 'marketers' and 'users', their taste shaping what the algorithm could surface
standards and classifications that vanish into the background until they break

config.why: Group identity is forged the way it is anywhere: against outsiders and through shared ordeal. Identity is also the data problem — the ethnographer is socialised too.

config.prompt: Susan Leigh Star's argument about what to study. Drag the divider.

before.label: the visible
before.text: Spectacle, events, decisions, the things a society puts on display and names as its achievements. The obvious objects of study — and the ones that flatter.

after.label: the invisible
after.text: Roads, standards, cables, classifications. They disappear into the background until they break — and studying modernity therefore means studying plumbing: how standards bodies negotiate a plug shape, how classifications sort people.

config.why: The defining artefacts of modernity are precisely the ones we are trained not to look at. Breakdown is the ethnographer's instrument: infrastructure becomes visible at the moment it fails.

config.prompt: In which year did Occupy Wall Street begin, with Graeber among its formative organisers?
config.why: 2011 — the same year as Graeber's Debt. Consensus process and general assemblies became an ethnographic spectacle: a prefigurative movement building the society it demanded, with hand signals replacing chairs.
config.context: The movement made its own decision procedure the object of study — prefiguration as argument.

config.prompt: The lesson's core claim is that socialisation never ends — it just changes workplaces. Order a physicist's formation:
items: Undergraduate problem sets select for a particular tolerance for deferred reward
Graduate school transmits the department's cosmology and its status economy
Detector authorship lists become the arena where rank is fought out
The senior physicist reproduces the same formation in the next cohort
config.why: Traweek showed physicists are made through decades-long socialisation into a culture — which means the lab is a field site, and its 'objectivity' is itself a local achievement worth describing.
